name: com.tolk2go/booking
title: Tolk2Go Interpreter Booking
description: Book and manage sworn and qualified interpreters (on-site, phone, video) for a Tolk2Go account.

tools.name: tolk2go_search_support_knowledge
tools.description: Search approved Tolk2Go knowledge: FAQ answers, workflows such as the booking workflow, and domain cards such as booking status meanings. Translate the user's question to English before calling this tool. Use it before answering questions about booking steps, booking statuses, services, policies, cancellation, payment, or use of Tolk2Go. Answer only from directly supporting returned passages. If the tool fails, times out, is unavailable, or returns no directly supporting passage, do not guess and offer human support when appropriate.

query.description: A concise English search query describing the user's Tolk2Go support question.

audience.description: Use client unless the user clearly identifies as an interpreter.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_languages
tools.description: Step 1 of booking, no key needed. List the languages Tolk2Go interprets, with their IDs. Pass a language ID to tolk2go_interpreting_list_language_pairs.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_language_pairs
tools.description: No key needed. List the bookable language pairs (for example Arabic–Dutch) with the language_pair_id that availability search and create_booking need. Filter with a language_id from tolk2go_interpreting_list_languages to keep the list short.

lang.description: Locale for names, e.g. nl, en, de or fr (default nl)

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_situations
tools.description: No key needed. List the situations (such as medical, legal, business or CBR exams) with the situation_id that availability search and create_booking need. Pick the one that matches the assignment. Situations with booking_flow catalog (such as CBR) book an item from tolk2go_interpreting_list_catalog.

lang.description: Locale for names, e.g. nl, en, de or fr (default nl)

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_qualifications
tools.description: No key needed. List the qualification types the search page filters on (such as Sworn Interpreter) and their providers (such as a national register). Pass the IDs as qualification_nodes to tolk2go_interpreting_search_availability when the customer requires a sworn or otherwise qualified interpreter.

lang.description: Locale for names, e.g. nl, en, de or fr (default nl)

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_catalog
tools.description: No key needed. For a situation with booking_flow catalog (such as cbr): its groups and items with code, name, duration_minutes and fixed price (excl. and incl. VAT; null for items priced per hour plus travel). Match what the customer says (a code such as VEE, or a name) to an item and ask the customer to choose when several match. Pass the item code as examCodeId to tolk2go_interpreting_search_availability and as catalog_item_code to tolk2go_interpreting_create_booking; end = start + duration_minutes.

situation_id.description: ID or slug from tolk2go_interpreting_list_situations, e.g. cbr

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_catalog_locations
tools.description: No key needed. The fixed exam locations (name, address, city, latitude, longitude) of a catalogue group with location_mode configured_locations, such as the CBR theory exam centres. Pick the one in the city the customer named (ask when there are several); search availability with its latitude and longitude and pass its name as exam_location to tolk2go_interpreting_create_booking. Do not ask the customer for the address.

situation_id.description: ID or slug from tolk2go_interpreting_list_situations, e.g. cbr

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_search_availability
tools.description: No key needed. Search interpreters for one assignment with the same filters and results as the tolk2go.com search page. Returns interpreter IDs, ratings and prices (excl. and incl. VAT) plus paging. Search again immediately before tolk2go_interpreting_create_booking so the IDs and prices are current.

start.description: Start, ISO-8601 with offset or UTC, e.g. 2026-11-20T09:00:00.000Z

type.description: phone = remote by phone or video; address = on site

lat.description: Latitude of the on-site address; required for type address

lng.description: Longitude of the on-site address; required for type address

sf_pm.description: Minimum price in EUR incl. VAT

sf_px.description: Maximum price in EUR incl. VAT

qualification_nodes.description: IDs from tolk2go_interpreting_list_qualifications; an interpreter matches any of them

sf_pp.description: Only interpreters with a profile picture

sf_pb.description: Only interpreters with a profile text

with_audio.description: Only interpreters with a voice recording

examCodeId.description: Item code from tolk2go_interpreting_list_catalog (e.g. VEE-IT); required for catalogue situations such as CBR, which also need type address with the exam location's lat and lng and end = start + the item's duration_minutes

offset.description: next_offset from the previous result while has_more is true

lang.description: Locale for names, e.g. nl, en, de or fr (default nl)

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_bookings
tools.description: List this account’s interpreter bookings, optionally returning only changes after a timestamp or cursor.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_pending_actions
tools.description: List what needs the customer across their open bookings, one entry per action: choose_interpreter (interpreters responded as available; next tolk2go_interpreting_get_responses and tolk2go_interpreting_preview_selection), pay (give the customer payment_url) or review_extra_cost (the interpreter proposed an extra cost; the customer accepts or declines it from the Tolk2Go email or app). An empty list means nothing waits on the customer. A change the customer requested waits on the interpreter and is not listed.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_get_booking
tools.description: Read the authoritative owner-scoped booking, payment, change and next-action state.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_get_responses
tools.description: Poll which interpreters responded as available for an owned booking request, with their interpreter_id. An empty list means wait (see polling.recommended_after_seconds on the booking) and poll again. Next: tolk2go_interpreting_preview_selection.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_create_booking
tools.description: Create an owner-scoped interpreter request for one start and end time. First get the IDs with the discovery tools and run tolk2go_interpreting_search_availability immediately before this call. preferred_interpreter_ids are the interpreters (one or more, from that search) who are asked first; offer several, or one when the customer wants a specific interpreter, for example one they booked before. If they are not available or do not answer in time, Tolk2Go automatically asks the next matching interpreters, up to 64 at a time. Interpreters usually respond within an hour (FAQ), so tell the customer the request is out and check tolk2go_interpreting_get_responses later.

delivery_mode.description: How the interpreter works; send this or the older type/phone_type

option.description: For remote: phone, tolk2go_video or other_remote

detail.description: Required for other_remote: how the session takes place

type.description: Deprecated, use delivery_mode: address = on_location, phone = remote

bookingTimezone.description: Required for remote bookings: the customer's IANA timezone, such as Europe/Amsterdam

client_reference.description: The customer's own reference. Required when the situation's reference has required true, such as the CBR candidate number (5 or more digits)

catalog_item_code.description: Required for catalogue situations such as CBR: item code from tolk2go_interpreting_list_catalog; the booking gets its duration and price

exam_location.description: For items in a group with location_mode configured_locations: location name from tolk2go_interpreting_list_catalog_locations; replaces location

candidate_name.description: Optional, catalogue situations: name of the exam candidate when that is not the account holder

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_preview_selection
tools.description: Read-only. The exact proposal that tolk2go_interpreting_select_interpreter would commit to for this interpreter: time, phone/video or on-site location, price incl. VAT, payment terms (upfront amount, refundable security deposit, deadline) and cancellation terms. When payment.deposit_terms is set, tell the customer that the upfront amount includes a refundable security deposit. Show it to the customer and get explicit approval before selecting.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_select_interpreter
tools.description: Book an interpreter who responded as available. This commits the customer: only call it after showing tolk2go_interpreting_preview_selection for the same interpreter and getting the customer’s explicit approval. If the result contains a payment URL, give it to the customer and poll tolk2go_interpreting_get_booking until the booking is confirmed.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_request_change
tools.description: Request a change to one of the signed-in customer's bookings. Put the new values in changes, using the create_booking field names: start, end, bookingTimezone, delivery_mode, location, description, situation_id or language_pair_id. The change goes through Tolk2Go's change approval flow, so it is not applied at once and the price can change; check tolk2go_interpreting_get_booking afterwards. CBR exam requests cannot be changed: cancel and create a new request instead.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel one of the signed-in customer's booking requests or bookings; this cannot be undone, so confirm with the customer first. A request that is still searching is withdrawn; a confirmed booking is cancelled under the cancellation terms shown by tolk2go_interpreting_preview_selection, so a late cancellation can be charged. Returns the booking_id with status cancelled, or an error when the booking cannot be cancelled (for example when it is already completed). The reason is optional.
